FACE MANIPULATION ANALYSIS
Likely manipulated

A check that has been tested with few false alarms found signs of manipulation.

Signs of face manipulation were found in the sampled frames

SUPPORTING SIGNALS AND EVIDENCE
The score is at or above the decision line, so the check reports signs of manipulation.
On the sealed half of FakeAVCeleb the frozen video threshold flagged 0.4 percent of the unmanipulated videos, so a flag was rarely a false alarm there.
On the sealed half of FakeAVCeleb the frozen video threshold caught 48 percent of the fake videos, so a missed fake is common.
Check: Face
